parameters.content:
## FORMIAL LABS - GEMINI + NANO BANANA
1. Select a Google AI Studio Header Auth credential in all five HTTP nodes: x-goog-api-key = your key.
2. Open Upload Creative Brief > Test URL and submit a product image.
3. Add your current logo.
4. Activate and use the Production Form URL.

Default: Nano Banana Pro, 4K, two separate creative takes. Gemini 3.1 Pro handles direction and individual reviews. One repair maximum. Images and report download as a ZIP.

No extra npm modules. See SETUP.md for details.

## BRAND IDENTITY
Website: green, serif formial LABS wordmark.
Public Instagram: newer silver / cool blue / teal; rebrand announcement.

Current social is the default theme. Upload current product and logo assets; they take priority. No package or logo is fabricated when missing.

Research: 2026-10-01. Sources and editable profile are in Brand Settings. Instagram review covered public bio and visible grid only.

## QUALITY CHECK
Original references accompany every generation and review. A pass needs score >=90, all seven checks true, zero issues, and the documented Gemini output dimensions.

One repair maximum. A worse repair never automatically replaces the original. Failures are labelled NEEDS REVIEW.

Gemini uses predefined canvases that can be slightly different from the nominal aspect ratio. No crop is applied. All requests are checked against a 19 MB inline limit.
